title: Certificates of Deposit: changing the maturity instruction, the interest disposition or the payout account
content:
## Scope

This policy governs changes an owner makes to the standing instructions of a Certificates of Deposit certificate: the maturity (renewal) instruction, the interest disposition and the payout account. Each tier supplies its own available interest dispositions and proceeds methods.

## Policy clauses

1. **When a change may be made.** The owner may change the maturity instruction, the interest disposition or the payout account at any time while the certificate is active or in its grace period.
2. **Interest disposition.** A disposition must be one of the tier's available interest dispositions, and it takes effect from the next crediting date.
3. **Payout account.** The payout account must be a checking or savings account of the same customer, in active status when the instruction is recorded. A payout instruction without such an account is not accepted.

## Retired wording (no longer in force)

The earlier clause "a change to the renewal instruction must be recorded before the grace period ends to govern this maturity; a change recorded after that governs the next maturity", as a timing rule for every change, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis for which maturity a change to the maturity instruction governs. Clauses 1 to 3 above remain in force.

## Basis of decision

Whether the payout account is a checking or savings account of the same customer, and whether it is active, is read from the bank's own records of that account at the time the instruction is recorded.

## Payout account check (hypothetical accounts)

| Account named as payout account | Accepted? |
|---|---|
| The owner's own checking account, active | Yes |
| The owner's own savings account, active | Yes |
| The owner's own checking account, closed | No |
| A checking account belonging to another customer | No |

## Points of judgement

**The owner changes the interest disposition in the middle of a month. Which credit does the change affect first?**
The next crediting date; the change takes effect from then.

**The owner asks for interest to be paid to checking on a tier whose only available disposition is compound. Can it be recorded?**
No. A disposition must be one of the tier's available interest dispositions.

**The owner names, for a payout instruction, a savings account that was closed last month. Is the instruction accepted?**
No. The payout account must be in active status when the instruction is recorded; a payout instruction without such an account is not accepted.

superseded_clauses: A change to the renewal instruction must be recorded before the grace period ends to govern this maturity; a change recorded after that governs the next maturity.
